query: Broadcom AI networking Tomahawk Ethernet revenue
normalized: ai broadcom ethernet networking revenue tomahawk

output.content:
Broadcom does **not** separately disclose revenue for the Tomahawk Ethernet-switch product family, so a standalone “Tomahawk revenue” figure cannot be derived from its reported financials. [[1]] 

The closest company-disclosed proxy is **AI networking revenue**: in fiscal Q2 2025, Broadcom reported AI semiconductor revenue of **more than $4.4 billion**, of which Ethernet-based AI networking was **40%**, implying AI-networking revenue of **more than approximately $1.76 billion** for the quarter. [[1]] 

That AI-networking figure is broader than Tomahawk: it includes Broadcom’s Ethernet networking portfolio used in AI clusters, while management said AI networking grew **over 70% year over year** in Q2 FY2025. [[1]] 

Tomahawk 6 was not the primary driver of that Q2 number, since initial shipments during the quarter were limited to proof-of-concept deployments; the revenue base was therefore principally supported by prior-generation Tomahawk switches and related Ethernet products, including Jericho routers. [[2]] 

For context, Broadcom reported total AI revenue of **$20.0 billion in FY2025**, but did not provide an annual networking/Tomahawk revenue split. [[3]]
